title: Numerical Methods
description: When an equation will not be solved, guess, and improve the guess. Newton's method doubles the correct digits at every step.

puzzle.goal: To find the square root of S from a guess x, write the next, better guess X (Heron's way).
puzzle.name: Newton step
puzzle.ask: Find X for x = 3 and S = @{S}.
puzzle.method: Newton on f(x) = x² − S: x − f/f′ = x − (x² − S)/(2x) = (x + S/x)/2.
